title: Alexander son of Amintas
summary: Raleigh names Alexander son of Amintas in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Alexander, the sonne of Amintas King of Macedon, great Grand-father to Alexander the Great, and afterwards King of Macedon himselfe. He is not Alexander the Great. The one-word title would fold onto that record, so the title is four words. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.
